name: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use
notes: Launch post and model card dated 7 October 2025. The model card says the model is based on Gemini 2.5 Pro (06-2025) with post-training for UI control, is primarily optimized for web browsers, shows promise on mobile UI control and is not yet optimized for OS-level control; its stated knowledge cutoff is January 2025. Benchmark figures on Online-Mind2Web, WebVoyager and AndroidWorld mix self-reported, Browserbase-run and Google-run evaluations. The post states that versions of the model power Project Mariner and the Firebase Testing Agent. This record covers the dated preview release; the Gemini API computer-use capability is recorded separately.
summary: Preview Google DeepMind model built on Gemini 2.5 Pro and post-trained for UI control, returning browser and mobile actions from screenshots and recent action history through the Gemini API computer_use tool.
